body: Session cleanup in project-6 on Central, on Greg's word via Advisor b9d13887 #2944 (2026-10-31 23:28Z): "Usuwanie bezpiecznie zidentyfikowanych nie wymaga kolejnej prosby". The route is POST /api/sessions/<id>/kill. It returns the full state snapshot (~25 MB), so send the output to a file. It has NO undo, it garbage-collects the delegated child sessions the session owns, and the host itself refuses on Engram removal obligations. Checks before a kill: GET /api/sessions/<id> (status, messageCount, pending prompts, queuePaused, the last assistant text) and GET /api/sessions/<id>/delegations (skip any session that owns delegations, since their review results may be cited as evidence). At 23:37Z I deleted 15: the empty Codex threads 7732, 8712, 8920, 9191–9196, 12826 and 15294, the empty 14598, plus O1-A 13930, WindowsB-Gate-Courier 14053 and CheckIn 11394. I kept CSharpProof 11519 (steps 2 and 3 open), UI 11881, Codex-WorkspaceLookupsFresh 11336 and PhoenixRunner 11410 (they own delegations), Grok 6721 (retained Engram prompt, paused), Architect1 8982 (stopped by Greg), and all active workers. I resumed Sol-license 12415 and Sol-c593 13170 (model-capacity errors; now active).
